create.name: Kanshoji Zen Monastery
create.bio:
Kanshoji, the Monastery of the Light of Kannon, is a Sōtō Zen monastery in the north of the Dordogne, inside the Périgord-Limousin regional nature park, set above a large lake ringed by forest. It was founded with the support of Dônin Minamisawa Zenji, abbot of Eiheiji, one of the two head temples of the Sōtō school, and one of its aims is to train monks and nuns who will pass the teaching on. Its abbot, Taiun Jean-Pierre Faure, was ordained in 1981 by Taisen Deshimaru, received Dharma transmission from Minamisawa Zenji in 2003 and has led the monastery since 2011.

The monastery describes itself as a school of life open to anyone who wants to discover or deepen Buddhist practice. Outside its programme, visitors can stay at any time of year and share the daily round of zazen, ceremonies, meals and work with the resident community. Through the year it holds silent sesshin led by the abbot, discovery weekends for newcomers, kesa-sewing workshops and a seminar on Dōgen's Shōbōgenzō. Teachings given during zazen, talks and question sessions are posted on its site, and every other Saturday it streams a session of Zazen Online on its YouTube channel.

courses.title: Retraite de l’Eveil du Bouddha
courses.description: A silent week-long sesshin led by Taiun Jean-Pierre Faure, honouring the Buddha's awakening with successive periods of zazen and walking meditation and a closing ceremony.

courses.title: Retraite d'hiver
courses.description: A sesshin spanning the turn of the year, closing one year and opening the next in zazen with the monastic community.

courses.title: Weekend découverte de février
courses.description: A weekend for people who have never practised zazen or never visited Kanshoji, introducing seated meditation and the monastery's daily life with the help of residents.

courses.title: Séminaire Shōbōgenzō 2027
courses.description: A study session with the abbot on Dōgen's Shōbōgenzō, starting with its first chapter, with periods of zazen between the study sessions.

free_resources.title: Kusen
free_resources.description: Transcribed teachings given orally during zazen at the monastery, published on its site.

free_resources.title: Teishō et conférences
free_resources.description: Written versions of the abbot's formal Dharma talks and lectures.
